content.rendered:
We will be dismissing schools early today, February 20th. The dismissal times are as follows:


10:30 a.m. High School and Middle Schools

11:45 a.m. All Elementary Schools.  Lunches will be served at elementary schools.

Bus routes 3 & 4 will be on snow routes.

All evening activities and events are cancelled.


This decision was made to be proactive given the following Winter Storm Warning from the National Weather Service: “Heavy snow. Snow accumulations of 1 to 2 inches through early to mid afternoon. Total snow accumulations of 3 to 7 inches, heaviest later this afternoon and tonight.”


We will be dismissing secondary students first at 10:30 a.m. in hopes that they can care for younger elementary students who will be dismissed at 11:45 a.m.  In addition, this gives elementary parents additional time to make arrangements, if needed.
